description:
The colossal squid is the heaviest invertebrate on Earth: about half a ton, with swivelling hooks on its tentacles and the biggest eyes of any animal on the planet. It lives in the freezing dark of the Southern Ocean around Antarctica, and until 2025 nobody had ever filmed one alive in the deep. In this video we go down into the deep sea to see how the colossal squid hunts, why sperm whales come back covered in its scars, what you could actually do if one grabbed you, and why this deep-sea monster might be the laziest predator in the ocean.
